title: Energy & Upgrades
note: Images are copied from game textures; machine and block images use a representative face. Crafting recipes may be overridden by modpacks. Machine crafting recipes describe how to build the machine, not its processing recipes.
scope: Energy cells, cores, portable batteries, wireless pylons, charging, configuration tools and machine/storage/conduit upgrades. Generators and wires have dedicated categories; creative-only items are covered separately.
